answer: The cheapest real defence: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because jetty only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, orchard is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any garden approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
